To keep a cell alive, it requires some essential substances such as regular supply of water, oxygen and nutrients etc. Likewise, metabolic wastes produced by the cell should also be eliminated from it. Metabolic wastes produced in tissues such as urea, uric acid, carbon dioxide, excess water etc. should be transported to the excretory organs for their elimination. Blood vascular system is the organ system that is responsible for the transportation of both useful and harmful substances to the required sites within the body. Specific organs such as heart, blood vessels and blood form blood vascular system or circulatory system in frog.
